title: Two Minutes
alt: Four panels. 1: In the office, Pip, happy, gestures toward a small door marked ROOF and asks Margo to come up for a minute. Margo, holding a folder, deadpan, says it's night. 2: On the rooftop under a pale peach sky, with a water tank and a city skyline, Margo stands worried beside Pip, who says not up here. 3: Silent. Margo and Pip stand at the parapet in front of the skyline and a rising sun. 4: Close-up. Margo, smiling slightly, says two minutes. Pip, beaming, begins counting it down: one fifty-nine.
hover: The window still says night. Down here.
transcript: Panel 1 – PIP: Come up. Just for a minute.
note: Pip learned the counting from somebody. I'm not saying who.
